EXACTLY straight ahead, level head, neutral expression. Square framing with headtop y5%, chin y95%, eyes y43%, mouth y72%, maximum headwidth about75%. Original painted dark-skin planes with clear restrained ochre highlights and plum-brown shadows, finely broken small oil brush strokes, readable light eyelids and tiny eye reflections. Matte diffuse surface, no gloss or dramatic illumination, no scene or lettering. This one face albedo will project onto an original fully volumetric articulated human model; no named champion, no copied person, no godlike face.
